findings.explanation: The church’s religious image of silence itself being baptized becomes generic clarity.

findings.highlight: He is like a heresy in it all
findings.evidenceJa: 火を見るように異端だった
findings.governingReading: Within it he was as unmistakably heretical as fire is visible
findings.explanation: The intruder’s glaring incompatibility with the church is rendered as malformed abstraction.

findings.evidenceJa: 枯れ木のように震える四肢
findings.governingReading: His limbs tremble like dead branches
findings.explanation: The image of his emaciated, brittle terror disappears.

findings.highlight: prey being chased by a hound
findings.governingReading: a mouse attacked by a hunting dog
findings.explanation: The humiliatingly small, cornered mouse image is generalized to any prey.

findings.highlight: You are the first one to come here
findings.evidenceJa: ここに足を運んだのは君が初めてだ
findings.governingReading: You are the first to seek your way here
findings.explanation: The first defeated Master to come for sanctuary is phrased as the first person to visit the church at all.
Kirei’s ritual authority is weakened into low volume.

findings.highlight: I don’t want to be a Master
findings.evidenceJa: マスターなんてやってられない
findings.governingReading: I cannot go on being a Master
findings.explanation: The boy’s panicked claim that the role is untenable becomes mere preference.

findings.highlight: As if to peer within his skin, bones, and meat
findings.evidenceJa: 皮の下、骨の隙間、肉の深部を捉えるように
findings.governingReading: As though fixing on what lay beneath the skin, between the bones, and deep in the flesh
findings.explanation: Kirei’s gaze penetrating successive anatomical layers is collapsed into an awkward list.

findings.highlight: my father who started this place
findings.evidenceJa: 管理者としてここに根付いた父
findings.governingReading: my father, who put down roots here as its overseer
findings.explanation: Kirei’s father’s established administrative role is changed into founding or constructing the church.

findings.highlight: she was only useful as a woman
findings.explanation: The mature-text branch inserts Shinji’s claim that Rider had sexual utility, absent from the active Japanese.

findings.highlight: they all got in my way
findings.evidenceJa: あいつら、そろって邪魔をしやがって
findings.governingReading: the two of them joined together to interfere
findings.explanation: The paired opponents in Shinji’s two-against-one complaint become an unspecified larger group.

findings.evidenceJa: 自らの障害を思い浮かべる
findings.governingReading: calls to mind those who obstructed him
findings.explanation: The objects of Shinji’s resentment are rendered in malformed, abstract English.
The extreme gentleness that makes Kirei’s manipulation uncanny is weakened to ordinary kindness.

findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=いんぎん char=2]慇懃な笑み
findings.explanation: Kirei’s formal, potentially insincere politeness becomes genuine friendliness, softening the scene’s menace.
